policy: Strictly open source: the helper is GPL-3.0 with its source in the release archive, it ships no committed binary, every dependency it bundles is version-pinned, and the Play client it builds comes from a pinned upstream revision.
No generic bypass, cracked licence, shared account, or pre-baked credential is hardcoded anywhere in the tool. Google Play enforces ownership.
Account credentials move only between the user's own machine and Google. Nothing is stored on, proxied through, or transmitted to a third-party server.
binaries_note: The published mcbedrock-get.exe and AppImage are build output, never committed. Any binary appearing in this tree must be declared here first.

built_from_source.role: The Play client the helper builds and drives on the user's own machine.
built_from_source.notes: Same revision as the port's own ARM64 gplaydl in the on-device downloader's PROVENANCE.json. Bump both together.

credential_artifacts.name: playdl.conf
credential_artifacts.where: the gplaydl prefix inside WSL, or under $XDG_DATA_HOME on Linux
credential_artifacts.holds: the account address and token handed to gplaydl

credential_artifacts.name: token_cache.conf
credential_artifacts.where: the gplaydl prefix inside WSL, or under $XDG_DATA_HOME on Linux

network.rule: Every host the helper can reach is listed here. Only hosts owned by Google may see account data; no other host is contacted while credentials exist in memory.

allowed.purpose: Google's own embedded sign-in page, rendered locally in the pywebview window. The password never leaves that page.
Play auth and delivery. Reached by gpsoauth for the token exchange and by gplaydl for the download; neither host name appears in this tree's source.
minecraft-linux/mcpelauncher-versiondb version lists. Public metadata only, fetched with no account context.
Pinned upstream Play-client source clone, and the project's own repository link in documentation.
Cited in documentation as the source of release names. Never contacted by the program.
